purpose: Non-secret source-of-truth for local agent runtime ownership and migration targets.
rules: Do not store API keys, bearer tokens, account IDs, or secret file contents here.
Use this manifest to answer where a runtime component lives before searching globally.
Move components into tools/agent-runtime in small, tested slices.

notes: Owns worker lifecycle, model catalog, Pi/Qwen/OpenCode harness adapters, log parsing, steering, polling, and cleanup.
Parser fixes should be ported here before this repo switches config to the local entry.
Routes Qwen, Pi, OpenCode, and external subagents through the same provider lanes.
Secrets must stay in user config/env, not in this repo.
Primary worker harness for external subagents.
Windows shell behavior, RPC stream parsing, MCP progressive disclosure, and foreground-tool observability belong in this seam.
Keep session-scoped browser profiles and broad MCP flags.
Do not auto-open docked DevTools panels during visual QA.
Rotates configured search providers and falls back to SearXNG.

migration_order: Create repo-local doctor and topology manifest.
Extract external-subagent parser and worker metadata tests into tools/agent-runtime/external-subagents.
Move MCP server entry to repo-local path and update Codex/Qwen/OpenCode MCP configs.
Move key-router source behind repo-local launch script while keeping secrets in user env/config.
Add repo-local smoke tests for start, poll, read, steer, cancel, and provider route identity.
Only after green smoke, remove old opencode-repo MCP path from user configs.
